title: admin handle_admin_connection returns Box<dyn Error> erasing error type
description: In admin.rs, handle_admin_connection returns Result<(), Box<dyn std::error::Error + Send + Sync>>. This is appropriate only for main() or binary entry points. Used in an internal async function it erases all type information, preventing callers from matching on specific failure modes. Should return a concrete error enum or anyhow::Error. The current type compiles but permanently loses error context.
